prompt: Locked-off static camera on a tripod, fixed frame, no camera movement at all: one continuous unbroken shot from the first frame. A silent horror film look, black and white, heavy film grain, gentle projector flicker, dust and scratches, the street lamp's pool of light on the bench. In the background the ambulance's roof beacon turns slowly the whole time, its pale beam sweeping round and round across the hospital front. [00:00-00:01] Stillness. The man in the top hat sits motionless, smiling straight into the lens, mouth closed, eyes fixed on us. [00:01-00:02] Without looking away from us, his gloved right hand, the one nearest the other person, makes one slow, lazy flick of the fingers towards the nurse, a bored brush-off, then drops back to rest. His smiling face stays frozen like a mask, perfectly still. [00:02-00:05] The tired nurse pushes herself up off the bench, turns her back to us and walks slowly away into the background, past the lamp post, towards the lit glass doors of the hospital, growing smaller as she goes. [00:05-00:06] The man has not moved: same closed-mouth smile, same unblinking stare into the lens, the empty half of the bench beside him, the ambulance beacon still turning behind. Silence, only a faint night hum. The camera stays completely still for the whole shot, one single take. Thanks.
